alternative.src/patch.mjs: export function applyPatch(lines,hunks){let end=0,shift=0;const inverse=[];for(const h of hunks){if(!Number.isInteger(h.at)||h.at<end||h.at>lines.length||h.at+h.remove.length>lines.length)throw new RangeError('range');for(let i=0;i<h.remove.length;i++)if(h.remove[i]!==lines[h.at+i])throw new Error('conflict');inverse.push({at:h.at+shift,remove:h.insert.slice(),insert:h.remove.slice()});shift+=h.insert.length-h.remove.length;end=h.at+h.remove.length;}const out=lines.slice();for(let i=hunks.length-1;i>=0;i--){const h=hunks[i];out.splice(h.at,h.remove.length,...h.insert);}return {lines:out,inverse:[{at:0,remove:out.slice(),insert:lines.slice()}]};}
